fields.longtitle: LBar permanent makeup studio services in Bucharest
fields.description: Services of our permanent makeup studio in Bucharest. Artists with 3+ years of experience ⭐ Affordable prices with a custom shape for you. 100% positive reviews

tvs.text-bl-seo:
Studio LBar offers eyebrow, lip and eyelid micropigmentation in the best-known and most popular techniques. Creating a natural, harmonious look is what sets us apart.

  • We know that every client has their own idea of beauty. That's why we offer micropigmentation in a variety of techniques. We offer:
  • Eyebrow micropigmentation: powder, hair-stroke, microblading, ombré and 3D/6D techniques.
  • Eye micropigmentation: lower/upper lash line, classic eyeliner, eyeliner with shading.
  • Lip micropigmentation in aquarelle and ombré techniques.
  • Beauty mark tattoo.

We also offer the following additional services:

  • Covering old tattoos, including unsuccessful work done by another artist. We handle even the most difficult cases, when the pigment has an unpleasant shade and an unattractive, uneven shape.
  • Correction of semi-permanent makeup done by one of our artists or by another artist.
  • Removal of tattoos and semi-permanent makeup with modern, high-performance equipment, with up to 98% guaranteed removal.

Whichever service you choose, we guarantee quality and sterile conditions. Reusable equipment goes through three-stage sterilization in line with all standards and requirements. Consumables are single-use and disposed of immediately after use. Single-use needles are opened in front of the client.

We stand for natural results and quality. Want a result that exceeds your expectations? Come to Lbar. Our micropigmentation services are at your disposal.
tvs.sub-title-bl2: Create a natural, elegant look and highlight your individuality. Choose the service that will make you truly happy.
